id: FP_内存泄露_013; FP_内存泄露-2_016
template: CLS_STATUS: Controllers (<*>) free memory is (<*>), alarm type(<*>)(<*>: fault, <*>:resume).

meaning: 控制器空闲内存告警，内存水位达到故障阈值
description: 异常参数为 free memory（控制器空闲内存量）。

template: CLS_FENCING: Node xnet sche timeout(<*>) block timeout(<*>) abnormal.

description: 异常参数为 sche timeout 和 block timeout。

template: Disk sn:2102313EDH10PA100245,dev: change state:<*> to state:<*>,be abnormal.
sample: Disk sn:2102313EDH10PA100245,dev: change state:0 to state:2,be abnormal.

id: FP_硬盘单链路_015; FP_硬盘慢盘_017
template: VBC: blk rq fail, bd <*> is invalid, bd state <*>.
sample: VBC: blk rq fail, bd 50331655 is invalid, bd state 3.
meaning: VBC层块请求失败，原因是BD（Block Descriptor）无效。BD无效表示块描述符状态异常，通常是因为底层设备不可达或状态不一致。
description: 异常参数为 bd 和 bd state。
